nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group of exponent $n$, and let $\mathbb{Q}(\zeta_n)$ be the $n$-th cyclotomic field. There is a ring homomorphism $\varphi \colon \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_n) \to \mathbb{C}$ such that for every finite-dimensional complex representation $\rho$ of $G$ on a vector space $V$ and every $g \in G$, the trace of $\rho(g)$ lies in the image of $\varphi$.
nodes.title: Character values of a finite group lie in a cyclotomic field

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group of exponent $n$, let $K = \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_n)$ be the $n$-th cyclotomic field, and let $\rho$ be a representation of $G$ on a finite-dimensional complex vector space $V$.
